notes:
Smart Cuff v3.1.402 fixes startup alignment for older unlocked SmartCuff devices A-H whose firmware predates outgoing telemetry checksums. The protected updater requires a live historical boot/version, readiness, matching device identity, complete explicit pump-off/vented IDLE telemetry, and continuously advancing time/sequence before erase. It inspects complete received batches before approval, including later unsafe or partial frames. The existing snapshot/upload/verified-restore transaction preserves the connected device's calibration and control settings.

Checksum-capable, unknown, silent, active and locked controllers retain the existing refusal boundaries. Startup reuses the already verified historical version without resetting the controller again just to read it.

Validation: 176 focused compatibility, integrity, startup, native, calibration-preservation and release checks plus the seven standard GUI checks passed. The read-only migration safety check passed on actual device A firmware233. Firmware remains rev27v-followup-355.

This release also includes the previously unreleased v3.1.400 SysID acquisition/recovery work: fresh whole-band evidence replaces superseded acquisitions after verified recovery, with the existing exposure and final quality gates. No new qualified SysID result is claimed.
